resolved_model_contract: AcceptanceGeneration(specifications, ready, findings, limits) is frozen, bounded and normalized by canonical identity. Exact duplicate specifications deduplicate; conflicting content/ownership or scenario-ID collisions fail. ready contains canonical candidate instances in the same order; error findings prohibit ready membership.

AcceptanceSpecification retains repository ownership separately from its closed JsonObject. Its identity and scenario_id are stable content-independent coordinates. Renderer never derives IDs from titles, statements, filenames or legacy three-ref keys.

acceptance_tags(identity, *, limits, mobile_applicable=False) is the shared tag authority. Preserve generated tags exactly in sorted order; do not re-infer mobile or alter offline from display text. Valid punctuation has no lossy escape. Renderer only checks output-safe shape/alphabet and duplicate/collision invariants.

proposed_public_api.file: @dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True) AcceptanceRenderedFile: path: str; content: bytes
proposed_public_api.contract: Pure function; exact carrier type only, no ready override, raw document sequence, path root, snapshot reload, validation mode or caller-injected validator. Inherit generation.limits for aggregate output capacity. Invalid shape/encoding/collisions raise ValueError or existing PathPolicyError; capacity raises ReportLimitError. Return no partial bundle; no I/O, grants, acceptance changes or step definitions.
proposed_public_api.authority: Only generation.ready emits executable scenarios. A document readiness=ready outside that subset remains withheld and visible in Markdown. Model construction checks consistency, not semantic proof: trusted service must call generate_acceptance on a captured snapshot, then render that exact result. Renderer output and Python type checks never become host/gate authority; untrusted serialized ready lists cannot enter via an adapter.

output_contract.names: Always acceptance.md. For each validated ready item: <kind>/<scenario_id>.feature, where kind is the closed legacy-characterization or target-acceptance value and scenario_id is the existing scn-<fullSHA256>. No user title/path determines a filename. Files tuple sorts ordinally by path; check portable collisions prospectively. No .feature file for empty ready population.
output_contract.markdown: acceptance.md is the complete traceable view and companion pending report: fixed summary/findings section plus canonically ordered ready and non-executable sections. Include source content digest, separate repository owner/pin, identity, complete source/evidence/decision refs, original given/when/then, pending reasons and retained findings/actions. Explicitly distinguish actual pending state from a ready-looking record withheld by validation; never relabel or drop either.
output_contract.gherkin: One file per ready specification. Fixed Feature title based on scenario_id; exact generated tags immediately before Scenario; Scenario name is scenario_id. Emit Given then And for ordered given statements, exactly one When, then Then/And for ordered expected statements. Empty given emits no invented setup. No Background, Rule, Examples, Scenario Outline, data table or doc string.
output_contract.statement_convention: Every authored statement is represented as one JSON string literal immediately after the fixed Gherkin keyword, using ensure_ascii=True and no physical newline. Example: Given "processor idle". Backslash, quote, control, CR/LF and non-ASCII characters escape reversibly; pipes and triple quotes remain inside that one quoted step text, never table/doc-string syntax. Preserve original strings in Markdown traceability. This is a declared display/step-text convention, not an assertion that an arbitrary consumer runner unescapes JSON or that matching step definitions exist.
output_contract.traceability: Gherkin comment lines use a fixed # prefix followed by one bounded ASCII-escaped sorted-key JSON object retaining owner, identity, digest and all source/evidence/decision refs; authored values cannot produce a second physical comment/tag/step line. Markdown uses fixed headings and JSON literal blocks rather than raw authored links, HTML or prose. JSON escaping keeps embedded newline/fence/control text inside a quoted value; no source reference is replaced by an imported destination or reconstructed hash.
output_contract.bounds: Use ReportBudget for structural/work reservations, but measure the selected ASCII JSON-string escaping and actual wrapper/keyword/comment/indent/LF bytes before creating strings or encoding. Reserve aggregate path and tag scans, record/statement/ref/finding traversal, maximum comparisons and all files+Markdown retained bytes before allocation. Same generation.limits caps the whole bundle, not each file independently. Validate Unicode scalars; fail without any partial files on exhaustion.

migrate_to_v2: test_positive_generation_maps_given_when_then: use schema-valid captured generator output; Then exactly the eligible criterion/approved scoped decision, not concatenated parity text.
test_positive_generation_derives_stable_id: use AcceptanceIdentity.scenario_id and retain the existing scenario discriminator plus source/client/platform/mode coordinates.
test_positive_generation_top_level_fields: closed acceptance-specification schema plus separate captured owner, not the legacy scenario-set envelope.
test_positive_generation_null_refs_when_none_match: explicit pending/withheld or blocking result with no executable fallback, not a synthetic ready cross-product.
